variation.name: bir52_tc_cessation_transfer
variation.description: A valid BIR52 tax computation for a partnership/sole proprietorship that ceased business during the basis period via transfer to another person. Includes all BIR52-specific cessation elements: BusinessCessation = true, BusinessCessationTransferred = true, BusinessCessationTransferee details, and BusinessCessationTransfereeBusinessNature (BIR52-only element).
